# babysit

MCP tools that help coding agents manage GitHub pull requests until they merge.
Use status and wait calls instead of repeated shell commands or sleep loops.

Run: npx -y --package=github:iceglober/babysit babysit
Needs Node 20+, npm, Git, and an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh).

Loop: babysit_status(pr) -> do what NEXT says -> babysit_wait(pr) -> repeat until done.
Pass a PR URL, owner/name#number, or a number with repo: "owner/name".
Use babysit_watch for several pull requests.
Only request a merge when the user authorizes it. Use dry_run: true to preview actions.

Repository configuration: .agent/.babysit.json
mergeQueue: "github", "mergify", null, or omitted. Mergify requires an explicit choice.

- README.md: Installation, configuration fields, and tool behavior.
- skills/babysit/SKILL.md: Agent workflow and rules for handling results.
